Resolves #21119

The example card is rebuilt as the full-bleed composition picked on the ticket. The 16:9 cover is the card; the title and the proof line stand on a scrim at its foot; the action, the limits and the source link open on hover, focus and selection, and at phone widths a tapped card opens under its cover. Featured becomes a two-column showcase. A record without a cover stays in the catalog and gets no card and no placeholder, and a family gets its tab with its first covered record. On `dev` that shows 30 of 76 records until #20679, #21120 and #21121 deliver covers.

Evidence: L3 (real Chromium against the local dev server: frames in both themes, the examples unit and e2e specs) → L3 required (rendered frames and the examples specs). Residual: AC-9, Residual-Owner: #20498.

![The built card on five tabs in both themes at 1440 px, beside the 13.4 list](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/829e6a2806cfa8df50eaf00c087605656b7f3024/review-evidence/21119/after-1440.jpg?raw=true)

![The built card at 390 px, at rest and tapped, beside the 13.4 list](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/829e6a2806cfa8df50eaf00c087605656b7f3024/review-evidence/21119/after-390.jpg?raw=true)

## Deltas from ticket

- Two files the ticket did not name: `TabContainer.mjs` (`hasCover()`, the cover filter on every family store, a class for Featured) and `TabContainerController.mjs` (a tab publishes by covered records). Prescription checked: these two own which records and tabs publish; `List.mjs` and its styles own the card.
- The light theme keeps a dark scrim with light text. A pale scrim over dark covers read as fog; a card is a picture in both themes.
- The scrim is solid behind the text and fades only inside its top padding. A gradient under the title failed 4.5:1 on a white cover.
- At phone widths the proof line rests on one line and a tapped card opens under its cover: 180 px of card do not hold an in-card reveal.
- Criteria 2 and 5 of the ticket were corrected to these measurements before this pull request opened.
- Out of scope, owned elsewhere: the covers themselves. Forms and Table Filtering still carry white whole-window shots (#20679, #21121).
- **Three inputs of #20724 are reversed here, named for the grade at the merge gate** (found by a trace of the record on 16 Nov; #21119 chose the full-bleed composition after the operator's read of that day and did not name them). Its criterion "essential information is not hidden behind hover": the action, the limits and the source link now open on hover, focus and selection, while the title and the proof line rest. The steward's constraint of 10 Nov that "captions must not cover the screenshot at phone width": the phone card rests with its caption on the cover and opens under it on tap. And the tinted glass the operator preferred on 10 Nov ("dark blue / purple surfaces with some transparency"): the scrim is a neutral dark.
- Until the covers of #20679 land, Grid & Table shows 4 of its 21 records, while `seo.json` on `dev` still says "Explore 21 live Neo.mjs Grid & Table examples". That sentence is not changed here and has to follow the cover rule.
- This ticket's parent is #21140 since 16 Nov.
